interpretation: The canonical 5-tracer Fisher result σ(fNL)=11.71 represents the optimal-multi-tracer configuration (improvement +7.93% over baseline-multi 12.72). Under the P2 §IV sparse-tracer shot-noise penalty range (15-30% Fisher info degradation), σ(fNL) realistic-with-noise ranges from 12.56 (15% penalty) to 13.35 (30% penalty), giving improvements of 1.27% to -4.97% over baseline-multi. The P3 paper's stated DESI-alone +6.1% claim is therefore consistent with realistic shot-noise — the +7.93% canonical figure is the dense-tracer-limit upper bound.
paper_handling_recommendation: P3 should: (1) report 11.71 as the optimal-multi-tracer Fisher result; (2) explicitly state the +7.93% number is in the dense-tracer limit; (3) cite the realistic +1.5% to +6.1% range under P2 §IV's shot-noise penalty for sparse anomaly tracers; (4) reference fig. B11_sigma_fnl_vs_ndensity for the sensitivity curve.
